package student

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
)

type diagnosticUCRepo struct {
	attempt                   domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt
	replayAttempt             domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt
	replay                    bool
	replayErr                 error
	reserveCalls, submitCalls int
}

func (f *diagnosticUCRepo) ReplayDiagnosticReservation(context.Context, string, string, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, bool, error) {
	return f.replayAttempt, f.replay, f.replayErr
}
func (f *diagnosticUCRepo) ReplayDiagnosticSubmission(context.Context, string, string, string, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, bool, error) {
	return f.replayAttempt, f.replay, f.replayErr
}
func (f *diagnosticUCRepo) ReserveDiagnosticAssessment(context.Context, repository.DiagnosticAssessmentReserveCommand) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, bool, error) {
	f.reserveCalls++
	return f.attempt, false, nil
}
func (f *diagnosticUCRepo) GetDiagnosticAssessment(context.Context, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, error) {
	return f.attempt, nil
}
func (f *diagnosticUCRepo) GetCurrentDiagnosticAssessment(context.Context, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, error) {
	return f.attempt, nil
}
func (f *diagnosticUCRepo) SubmitDiagnosticAssessment(context.Context, repository.DiagnosticAssessmentSubmitCommand) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt, bool, error) {
	f.submitCalls++
	return f.attempt, false, nil
}
func (f *diagnosticUCRepo) CompleteDiagnosticAssessment(context.Context, repository.DiagnosticAssessmentCompleteCommand) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult, bool, error) {
	return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult{}, false, nil
}

type diagnosticUCCatalog struct {
	catalog domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog
	calls   int
	err     error
}

func (f *diagnosticUCCatalog) GetDiagnosticAssessmentCatalog(context.Context, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog, error) {
	f.calls++
	return f.catalog, f.err
}

type diagnosticUCTasks struct {
	task  *answer.TaskMetadata
	calls int
	err   error
}

func (f *diagnosticUCTasks) GetTask(context.Context, string) (*answer.TaskMetadata, error) {
	f.calls++
	return f.task, f.err
}
func (f *diagnosticUCTasks) GetDiagnosticTask(context.Context, string) (*answer.TaskMetadata, error) {
	f.calls++
	return f.task, f.err
}
func (f *diagnosticUCTasks) GetCourseStructure(context.Context, string) (*answer.CourseStructure, error) {
	return nil, errors.New("not used")
}

type diagnosticUCClock struct{ now time.Time }

func (f diagnosticUCClock) Now() time.Time { return f.now }

func diagnosticUCPlan() domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan {
	p := domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{Schema: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanSchema, ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", PlanRevision: 1, PolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPolicy, OnboardingVersion: 1, BootstrapPolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticBootstrapPolicy, BootstrapContextDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("c", 64), CourseContentRevision: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64), CreatedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		p.Assessments = append(p.Assessments, domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanItem{LessonID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", TaskID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-55555555555" + string(rune('0'+i)), TaskVersion: 1, UpdatedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 2+i, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), LessonOrder: i, TaskOrder: i, LearningTargets: []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.syntax", Version: "v1"}}})
	}
	p.PlanDigest, _ = domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanDigest(p)
	return p
}
func diagnosticUCCatalogFor(p domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan) domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog {
	c := domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{Schema: "course-diagnostic-assessment-catalog.v1", CourseID: p.CourseID, CurriculumRevision: p.CourseContentRevision}
	for _, i := range p.Assessments {
		c.Items = append(c.Items, domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalogItem{LessonID: i.LessonID, TaskID: i.TaskID, TaskVersion: i.TaskVersion, UpdatedAt: i.UpdatedAt, LessonOrder: i.LessonOrder, TaskOrder: i.TaskOrder, AssessmentPurpose: "diagnostic", LearningTargets: i.LearningTargets})
	}
	return c
}

func TestDiagnosticReserveRejectsStaleCatalogBeforeRepository(t *testing.T) {
	p := diagnosticUCPlan()
	catalog := diagnosticUCCatalogFor(p)
	catalog.Items[0].TaskVersion++
	repo := &diagnosticUCRepo{}
	cat := &diagnosticUCCatalog{catalog: catalog}
	uc := DiagnosticAssessments{Attempts: repo, Catalog: cat, Clock: diagnosticUCClock{now: time.Unix(1, 0)}}
	_, _, err := uc.Reserve(context.Background(), ReserveDiagnosticAssessmentInput{Plan: p, RequestID: p.ID, RequestHash: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64)})
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) || repo.reserveCalls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("stale reserve err=%v calls=%d", err, repo.reserveCalls)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticReserveReplaySkipsCatalogAndRepository(t *testing.T) {
	p := diagnosticUCPlan()
	replay := domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{ID: p.ID, PlanID: p.ID}
	repo := &diagnosticUCRepo{replayAttempt: replay, replay: true}
	cat := &diagnosticUCCatalog{err: errors.New("catalog unavailable")}
	uc := DiagnosticAssessments{Attempts: repo, Catalog: cat}
	attempt, replayed, err := uc.Reserve(context.Background(), ReserveDiagnosticAssessmentInput{Plan: p, RequestID: p.ID, RequestHash: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64)})
	if err != nil || !replayed || attempt.ID != p.ID || cat.calls != 0 || repo.reserveCalls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("reserve replay=%+v replayed=%v err=%v catalog=%d repo=%d", attempt, replayed, err, cat.calls, repo.reserveCalls)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticSubmitReplaySkipsTaskProviderAndConflictingReplayFails(t *testing.T) {
	p := diagnosticUCPlan()
	attempt := domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{ID: p.ID, StudentID: p.StudentID, Items: p.Assessments}
	task := &diagnosticUCTasks{err: errors.New("course unavailable")}
	repo := &diagnosticUCRepo{attempt: attempt, replayAttempt: attempt, replay: true}
	uc := DiagnosticAssessments{Attempts: repo, Tasks: task}
	got, replayed, err := uc.Submit(context.Background(), SubmitDiagnosticAssessmentInput{StudentID: p.StudentID, AttemptID: p.ID, TaskID: p.Assessments[0].TaskID, RequestID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", RequestHash: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64)})
	if err != nil || !replayed || got.ID != p.ID || task.calls != 0 || repo.submitCalls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("submit replay=%+v replayed=%v err=%v task=%d repo=%d", got, replayed, err, task.calls, repo.submitCalls)
	}
	repo.replay = false
	repo.replayErr = domain.ErrConflict
	if _, _, err := uc.Submit(context.Background(), SubmitDiagnosticAssessmentInput{StudentID: p.StudentID, AttemptID: p.ID, TaskID: p.Assessments[0].TaskID, RequestID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", RequestHash: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64)}); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) || task.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("conflicting replay err=%v task=%d", err, task.calls)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticSubmitUsesFrozenTaskAndPureScorer(t *testing.T) {
	p := diagnosticUCPlan()
	p.Assessments = p.Assessments[:3]
	attempt := domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{ID: p.ID, StudentID: p.StudentID, Items: p.Assessments}
	testID := "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
	variantID := "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"
	task := &diagnosticUCTasks{task: &answer.TaskMetadata{ID: p.Assessments[0].TaskID, LessonID: p.Assessments[0].LessonID, Version: 1, UpdatedAt: p.Assessments[0].UpdatedAt, Type: 11, EvaluationMode: "AUTO", AssessmentPurpose: "diagnostic", LearningTargets: p.Assessments[0].LearningTargets, Tests: []answer.TaskTestMetadata{{ID: testID, Kind: "single_choice", Variants: []answer.TaskTestVariantMetadata{{ID: variantID, IsCorrect: true}}}}}}
	repo := &diagnosticUCRepo{attempt: attempt}
	uc := DiagnosticAssessments{Attempts: repo, Tasks: task}
	body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"answers": []any{map[string]string{"test_id": testID, "variant_id": variantID}}})
	_, _, err := uc.Submit(context.Background(), SubmitDiagnosticAssessmentInput{StudentID: p.StudentID, AttemptID: p.ID, TaskID: p.Assessments[0].TaskID, RequestID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", RequestHash: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64), Response: body})
	if err != nil || repo.submitCalls != 1 || task.calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("submit err=%v calls=%d task_calls=%d", err, repo.submitCalls, task.calls)
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticSubmitRejectsFrozenTaskDriftBeforePersistence(t *testing.T) {
	p := diagnosticUCPlan()
	attempt := domain.DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt{ID: p.ID, StudentID: p.StudentID, Items: p.Assessments}
	base := &answer.TaskMetadata{ID: p.Assessments[0].TaskID, LessonID: p.Assessments[0].LessonID, Version: 1, UpdatedAt: p.Assessments[0].UpdatedAt, Type: 11, EvaluationMode: "AUTO", AssessmentPurpose: "diagnostic", LearningTargets: p.Assessments[0].LearningTargets}
	for name, mutate := range map[string]func(*answer.TaskMetadata){
		"version":         func(task *answer.TaskMetadata) { task.Version++ },
		"updated_at":      func(task *answer.TaskMetadata) { task.UpdatedAt = task.UpdatedAt.Add(time.Second) },
		"purpose":         func(task *answer.TaskMetadata) { task.AssessmentPurpose = "practice" },
		"evaluation mode": func(task *answer.TaskMetadata) { task.EvaluationMode = "MANUAL" },
		"type":            func(task *answer.TaskMetadata) { task.Type = 1 },
		"targets": func(task *answer.TaskMetadata) {
			task.LearningTargets = []domain.LearningTargetRef{{Type: domain.LearningTargetConcept, Key: "go.other", Version: "v1"}}
		},
	} {
		task := *base
		mutate(&task)
		repo := &diagnosticUCRepo{attempt: attempt}
		provider := &diagnosticUCTasks{task: &task}
		uc := DiagnosticAssessments{Attempts: repo, Tasks: provider}
		_, _, err := uc.Submit(context.Background(), SubmitDiagnosticAssessmentInput{StudentID: p.StudentID, AttemptID: p.ID, TaskID: p.Assessments[0].TaskID, RequestID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", RequestHash: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64), Response: json.RawMessage(`{"answers":[]}`)})
		if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) || repo.submitCalls != 0 {
			t.Errorf("%s drift err=%v persistence_calls=%d", name, err, repo.submitCalls)
		}
	}
}
